name: LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) Technical Design Report
notes: 392 pages; submitted to the Department of Energy for the CD-2 and CD-3 management processes.

summary.plain: The full engineering plan for the LZ detector, written before it was built.
summary.technical: LZ TDR (arXiv:1703.09144, LBNL-1007256, March 2017): design of the detector to be built at SURF, targeting a spin-independent WIMP-nucleon sensitivity of 3e-48 cm2.
